intro: Most of Guyana is rainforest, with people living mainly on the coast below sea level.

chapters.title: Forest and falls
text: About 85% of Guyana is forest. Kaieteur Falls is one of the most powerful single-drop waterfalls in the world. The Rupununi savanna is home to giant otters and anteaters.
The coast is protected by sea walls built by the Dutch.

chapters.title: Climate
text: Guyana is hot and wet, with two rainy seasons.

keyTerms.meaning: A wall that keeps the sea out.

places.title: Landscape tour
places.intro: Places that show the variety of Guyana's landscapes. The numbers match the pins on the map.
